articles.title: AIR raises $50M to help companies vet the skills and add-ons AI agents use
articles.summary: AIR's platform can discover agents running at a company, continuously vets any skills and add-ons they use, and blocks any unwanted behaviour.

articles.title: Fambot introduces an ‘AI chief of staff’ for families
articles.summary: Fambot is building an AI “chief of staff” to help families manage the emails, calendars, school updates, sports schedules, and other logistics of raising kids.

articles.title: Google Pics is like Canva, but with even more AI
articles.summary: Google has a new suite of creative design tools for Workspace users called Google Pics, which aims to make editing and generating "professional-grade" AI images less cumbersome for businesses. articles.title: Nvidia’s controversial DLSS 5 arrives September 3rd and requires serious GPU horsepower
articles.summary: Nvidia is officially launching DLSS 5 this week, following a divisive announcement in March where we likened the AI upscaling tech to a "real-time generative AI filter for video games" and "motion smoothing for video games, but worse." DLSS 5 will officially be available on RTX 50-series desktop and laptop GPUs and through GeForce Now […]

articles.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
articles.summary: Versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok will join Google's Gemini on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools.

articles.title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
articles.summary: As frustration over AI influencers has been growing, Instagram is limiting the reach of undisclosed AI profiles.

articles.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a ‘Harvey for police officers’
articles.summary: Blue Voice is trained on department-specific laws, local ordinances, protocols, and guidelines that general-purpose AI tools can't access on the public internet.

articles.title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M
articles.summary: The three-year-old startup says it reached $15 million in ARR and profitability before raising its latest $15 million round.

articles.title: Debian won’t ban AI code from its Linux distribution
articles.summary: Debian voted to allow developers to use AI tools in their contributions to the Linux distribution's "development, maintenance, [and] documentation."
